page.layout: One printed page of text, single column of catalogue entries, with a title block at the top and a page number and catchword at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: CATALOGUS LIBRORUM Præcipuorum, quos JORDANUS LUCHTMANS Typis edidit.
main_text.p: ARINTS Commentarius Novus in Historiam Tentationis Christi à Diabolo illatæ, in Locum Matth. 4: 1–12[?]. in octavo.
Admiranda Rerum admirabilium encomia, sive diserta & amœna Pallas. cum fig. 12.

ARS MAGNA & Admirabilis, speciminibus variis confirmata, qua Pandectarum Tituli, Eorumque præcipuæ materiæ, Ope figurarum Emblematicarum, Brevissimè Jucundè, & renaciter[?], memoriæ imprimi, firmiter Contineri, & Opportunè in usum transferri possunt: in maximum commodum Legum Studiosis. 8.

BLANCARDI (STEPHANI) ANATOMIA NOVISSIMA REFORMATA, sive CONCINNA CORPORIS HUMANI dissectio, ad Neotericorum mentem adornata plurimisque Tabulis Chalcographicis illustrata, accedit ejusdem Authoris de BALSAMATIONE nova methodus à nemine authac[?] hoc modo descripta. 8.
--- Opera Medica, Theoretica, practica & Chirurgica. 2 voll. in quarto. cum fig.
--- Anatomia practica Rationalis Sive Rationum Cadaverum Morbis Denatorum Anat. inspectio. duodecimo.
--- Traité de la verole, in octavo.
BONTEKOE fundamenta Medica sive de Alcali & Acido, in octavo.

BARTHOLINI (THOMAE) ANATOMIA, ex omnium Veterum Recentiorumque observationibus, inprimis Institutionibus B. M. parentis Caspari BARTHOLINI ad Circulationem Harvejanam & vasa Lymphatica quintum Resovata[?] cum Iconibus Novis & indicibus. 8.
BOCHARTI (SAMUELIS) Opera Omnia, hoc est Phaleg, Canaan & Hierozoicon; Accedunt variæ Dissertationes Philologicæ, Geographicæ, Chronologicæ, Historicæ, &c. Antehac ineditæ. 2 voll. fol.
BUXTORFII. Epitome Grammaticæ Hebr. ex Edit. J. Leusden. 8.
BIN. BROECKHUYSEN Oeconomia Corporis Animalis sive Cogitationes succinctæ, de Mente, Corpore, & utriusque conjunctione, juxta Methodum philosophiæ Cartesianæ Deducta. in quarto.

GISB. COCQUII Hobbesianismi Anatome, qua innumeris Assertionibus ex tractatibus de Homine, Cive, Leviathan juxta seriem Locorum Theologiæ Christianæ Philosophi illius à Religione Christianâ Apostasia Demonstratur, & refutatur. in octavo.
BERG: (CLEM:) Introductio in Doctrinam Politicam, secundum meliora Politicorum Recentiorum Principia, ad usum Academiarum adornata. 12.

JOH: JACOB: CRAMERUS de Ara Exteriore Templi secundi exercitationes Philologicæ; ubi ea ex authoribus Hebraeis exponitur, & cum Gentium Aris conferter[?], denique ad Christianorum Altaria tum externa, tum Mysticum, applicatur. 4.
THEODORI CRAANEN Animadversiones Medicæ Theoretico-Practicæ, in Henrici Regii Praxin Medicam, quibus editio prior ejusdem emendatur ex editione Joh: Broen. 4.

GUALTERI CHARLETONI Inquisitiones Medico-Physicæ de causis catameniorum, sive fluxus menstrui; nec non uteri Rheumatismo sive fluore albo. In qua etiam nervosæ probatur sanguinem in animali fermentescere nonquam[?]. 12.

page.notes: Stain and show-through along the left edge. A library or collector's stamp overlaps the entries "Anatomia practica" and "Traité de la verole" and the lines of Bartholini; the words under it are read as far as possible. "Resovata" appears as printed, probably for "Renovata". "Locum Matth. 4: 1–12" is uncertain, the figure after the dash is hard to read. Several words are doubtful and marked [?]: "renaciter", "authac", "conferter", "nonquam". Each entry is one printed line group and is given as its own paragraph. The catchword "FRE-" sits at the lower right.
